blocks.content: This step is optional. Use Overview when you already have named segments and want one mode for every segment you select. Skip it when only the Default segment exists. Overview lists segments that still have auto-apply off, so after you turn it on for Default there is nothing further to select there. These are the same modes as for the Default segment.

1. Open **Adaptive Metrics**.
1. On **Overview**, click **Enable auto-apply** next to the **Segment** dropdown.
1. Select the segments. Overview lists the segments that still have auto-apply off.
1. Select an **Auto-apply mode**. That mode applies to every segment you selected.
1. Click **Apply**.
